hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *CLAUDE.md) echo '[hook] WARNING: every CLAUDE.md is a one-line @AGENTS.md shim. Put the content in the matching AGENTS.md instead (see adr/0001-agent-docs-structure.md).' ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *.ts|*.js|*.cjs|*.json|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml) bunx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$CLAUDE_FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac

case "$CLAUDE_FILE" in *src/*.ts|*scripts/*.ts) echo '[hook] Logic changed. Pin the behaviour with a failing test first (red-green), then run: bun run check (the validate agent) before you open a PR.' ;; *.dependency-cruiser.cjs|*bunfig.toml|*tsconfig.json|*eslint.config.js|*knip.json|*package.json) echo '[hook] A check config changed. Run: bun run check, and update the AGENTS.md Commands and Gotchas if a fact changed.' ;; esac
